scope.summary: Implement the single unified geometry-operation set over the VectorEngine boolean core as typed operator+model commands: Union, Subtract (Minus Front), Intersect, Exclude (XOR), Divide, Trim/Merge, Crop, Outline, Minus Back, Offset/Expand-stroke. Operations are deterministic + repeatable (byte-identical output for same input + z-order), and each op's z-order dependence is documented in its typed contract so a model predicts the result from selection order alone.
acceptance_criteria: 10 unified geometry ops deterministic + z-order-documented; author_ids + manual entry
expected_tests: argus: geometry-operations panel reachable via author_id
test: each op byte-identical for same input+z-order; z-order-dependent ops (subtract/minus/crop/trim) documented + verified from selection order

target_entries: Studio / Vector / Geometry operations (union, subtract, intersect, ...)

risk_if_missed: No boolean/geometry ops; shape composition impossible.

risks: Scaffold-only claim without runtime proof (Spec-Realism Gate).
Domain MT forking a canonical primitive instead of referencing 14.23.
PostgreSQL/SQLite creep or a write that bypasses the typed SurrealDB boundary on a studio_* authority path.
minimum_controls: At least one proof command exercises executable runtime or a Handshake-managed resource boundary.
Reference canonical primitives (14.23); no shadow primitives.
no_legacy_database_tripwire plus typed-SurrealDB-boundary proof on every authority write.
